issue.description:
ADR-002 commits to agent-guided rehydration and names the unsupported scale case in its own drawbacks: large repositories need batching, resumable reconciliation reports, and duplicate detection. Deliver agent-facing support for these — a documented, stable reconciliation-report shape with resume points, batch checkpointing, and a duplicate-detection aid — while keeping reports non-native (never accepted as store input) and preserving the no-cross-tool-import boundary.

---
Priority: P3
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Rehydration aids for large source repositories: batching, resumable reconciliation reports, duplicate detection
